name: hordeshooter-match
note: hordeshooter_auto: two bots hold the yard for 900 ticks (15 s). The crowd, the shots and the blasts are all simulation, so every host agrees on the state.

name: hordeshooter-pace
note: hordeshooter_auto: two bots for 40 s: first kill, the first upgrade choices (bots pick), wave 2. Exact state on every host. Re-pinned 2026-10-29 (H-PT5): a wave is 25 s now (LEVELS.md), so wave 2 starts at tick 1500, not 1800: more of the run is wave 2.

name: arenafps-match
note: arenafps_auto: four seats (the AUTO bot count adds none) play Foundry deathmatch by themselves for 20 seconds. The simulation (movers, navmesh paths, shots, rockets, pickups) must give the same state on every host, so fighters.pos, scores and the state hash are compared exactly; pixels within the usual tolerance (particles, decals). Control: one frame short. WebGPU vs GL within 40 percent: at frame 1200 two of the four views face a wall at arm's length, and close-up texture detail (normal and roughness maps at that distance) differs between the backends (33 percent of pixels over 16 levels, 42 to 50 percent in those two views, 19 to 21 in the others, mean brightness equal: an engine finding in internal-cartwheel/findings/arenafps.md). No shake (2026-10-29): cam.offset is every view's camera as drawn against the eye and aim on the 655 ticks within half a second of a hit taken or a blast within 14 m; none is off by over 0.1 mm or 0.1 milliradian (a build with the old shake measured 575 of 581 off, up to 14 cm and radians summed). rumble.sent: blasts, hits taken, hits dealt and kills, landings, rocket and rail shots sent to the players' pads; cw.rumble the engine's last request (a landing on pad 3). The gate pins High with a start command: Chromium is not a deterministic host, so Auto stays on there and since engine v0.27 it steps down on a loaded machine.

name: arenafps-screenshot
note: A four-way split frame is a real picture (the arenas' colours, HUD, effects), not one flat colour. Pixels within 1 percent: a spent casing in flight (a visual particle) and the 1 px edges of the HUD bars differ between native GL and the dual cart on romdev GL (0.32 percent measured); the match gate allows 8 percent for the same reasons.

name: arenafps-coop
note: Co-op waves, three players (bots fill the seats) in the Courtyard: wave spawns, lives and bot paths must agree on every host. Control: two players.

name: arenafps-tdm
note: Team deathmatch in the Terraces (water), four players and four bots, 30 s. Control: three players.

name: arenafps-recoil
note: recoil belongs to the gun model, never the view (monteslu: no camera shake ever). One pad through the setup with no bots, then hold the trigger with the look stick at rest for 3 and 2 seconds: cam.fire counts the ticks fired and those on which the view moved; the rifle's burst walks its shots and opens the crosshair instead. Control ARENA_RECOIL_BUG=1 (the old climb) moves the view on every shot. The gate pins High with a start command: Chromium is not a deterministic host, so Auto stays on there and since engine v0.27 it steps down on a loaded machine.

name: arenafps-camera
note: camera stability, the way a person plays: one pad through title, join and the setup (no bots: up three rows, right, down three, fire), then stand, walk, stop, strafe, jump and stand on Foundry while player 1's camera as drawn is measured every tick (cam.gate: ticks at rest, at-rest ticks that moved over 1 mm, ticks in motion, ticks in motion on the ground where the eye jumped over 0.6 m or its step changed by over 15 cm). At rest it must not move at all (no bob, roll, dip or sway); stairs and kerbs ease the eye up instead of snapping it. Measured on engine v0.25.0: [478, 0, 650, 0] on native GL and WebGPU (it was [528, 0, 600, 0] before fighters spawned facing the longest clear way: the split between rest and motion moved, the two zeros did not). The control (ARENA_CAM_BUG, native) puts a 1 cm idle sway on the camera, so the second number leaves zero: it must differ. The gate pins High with a start command: Chromium is not a deterministic host, so Auto stays on there and since engine v0.27 it steps down on a loaded machine.

name: hordeshooter-calm-camera
note: no camera shake: three bots at the run's wave 13 (the ossuary's wave 3, its own level) for 900 ticks (112 blasts: rockets, grenades, bloaters, mines). view.cam_jerks counts frames whose camera position has a second difference over 2 cm (a shake; the smooth follow never does): 0. cw.rumble (requests, pad, low and high in thousandths, ms) shows the pads rumble instead: 175 requests, the last a blast. Re-measured 2026-10-29 on native GL when the ossuary came in (was 178 blasts in the yard). The control (HORDE_SHAKE_CONTROL, the same 900 ticks) puts the old explosion-kit camera shake back: 731 jerking frames and the same game.hash (the shake was never in the simulation), so it must differ.

name: hordeshooter-melee
note: enemy melee: one player standing still while a runner and a brute walk in (HORDE_MELEE_TEST, no spawning). Each attack plays its clip (melee.attack_frames: frames that drew an enemy in a wind-up, strike or recovery pose: 352) and its damage lands on the strike tick, the wind-up after it began (melee.hit_delay per kind: the runner 15 ticks, the brute 34), not on touch: 14 strikes, 10 hits, the player downed (-3 hp). Measured 2026-10-29 on native GL. The control (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=1: the player steps away from every wind-up) must differ.

name: hordeshooter-melee-dodge
note: dodging works: the same scene with the player stepping straight away from every enemy winding up at it (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=1): 9 strikes, 0 hits, full health (the damage needs the player still in reach and in front on the strike tick). Measured 2026-10-29 on native GL. The control (HORDE_MELEE_DODGE=0: standing still) takes hits and must differ.

name: hordeshooter-floor
note: a floor ends and the next begins: three bots from the yard's boss wave (HORDE_WAVE=5, floor 1 wave 5). The boss falls at tick 2573 (the bots make it their target when it is in range), the horde burns to ash over 90 ticks (floor.clear_tick 2663, no enemy left when the hatch opens: floor.left_at_hatch 0), the hatch opens over 60 ticks, the boss's loot caches fall and the bots gather them, then one finds its way to the hatch round the walls and steps in at 2912, and the second floor, the sluice with its own layout, starts at 2972 (floor.level 1, its waves under way: 523 enemies at tick 7800). Measured 2026-10-29 on native GL. The control (HORDE_FLOOR_STAY=1: nobody steps in) stays on the first floor with the hatch open and must differ.
